description.value: Horstman House is a boutique collection of one-to-three bedroom condominium-style residences perched on Blackcomb Mountain, steps from the Home Run trail and Lost Lake Park. Touted as one of Whistler's only true luxury private residence accommodations, it offers ski-in access and a free shuttle to both Whistler and Blackcomb lifts. The property sits close to Whistler Village and features in-unit full kitchens and washer/dryers, making extended stays comfortable for active travellers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and corroborates OSM contact details (local phone 604-935-3495, address 4653 Blackcomb Way, Whistler, BC V8E 0Y9). Amenities are listed explicitly on the front page and /amenities subpage: Free WiFi, free garage parking, in-unit washer/dryers, ski storage, heated outdoor pool, hot tub, fitness center, and a free area shuttle. No mention of bike-specific storage, bike procedure, drying area, e-bike charging, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site, though 'Bike Rentals' appears as a featured link suggesting some cycling awareness.
concerns: Website lists a toll-free number (1-888-621-1177) not present in OSM tags; OSM only captures the local line (+1-604-935-3495), which the website corroborates.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable accommodation in Whistler with a fully functional website, confirmed contact details, and a 'Bike Rentals' featured link indicating some cycling relevance. No grounds for exclusion.
